lines.text: Hiram king of Tyre sends envoys, cedar logs, stonemasons, and carpenters to build David a temple, and David sees the LORD has established him.
In Jerusalem David takes more wives and fathers more sons and daughters, including Solomon.
When the Philistines raid the Valley of Rephaim, David inquires of God, and the LORD promises to deliver them into his hand.
David defeats the Philistines at Baal-perazim, and he orders their abandoned gods buried in the valley.
David asks God again, circles around to the balsam trees, and strikes down the Philistines from Gibeon to Gezer, and his fame spreads.
